BiblicalUsage: Azgad is the name of a family that came back from Babylon — more than two thousand of them under Zerubbabel, a hundred and ten under Ezra, and one of their sons among those who sealed the covenant. A family that went into exile and came home to rebuild.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts returning families one by one, and Azgad's name in three lists is his way of saying none of them were forgotten.
